title: Recording Fri 13 Nov 09:34

tldr: Native dispatch demo to TCA went well: small additive feedback only, and it cuts their dispatch process from about 40 clicks to three.
Next step is a test against the TCA endpoint to prove it works, then give TCA an account so they can run single manual orders.

TCA is separately testing their API against the selector server from Manhattan, with a first test targeted for 30 November and a push to move to MVP2 (API). Conversations with them are slow, so the CSV route may stay for a while.
Monday's in-person session is about how to engage the American counterparts: who has authority on their side, plus an org chart. No further prep is planned.
Carrier proxy mocks exist and the selector test environment may get access to them.
decisions: Do a test against the TCA endpoint first, then give TCA an account to run manual orders.
No further prep for Monday beyond what has been done; nobody will research US carriers beforehand.
Meet in person on Monday at 11, with arrival around 8.30 and a half-hour travel buffer.
